aggregate_sum: SELECT CAST(user_id AS VARCHAR) AS user_id, CAST(SUM(amount) AS VARCHAR) AS total FROM read_csv_auto('examples/orders.csv', sample_size=-1) GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY user_id
distinct_all: SELECT DISTINCT CAST(id AS VARCHAR) AS id, CAST(name AS VARCHAR) AS name FROM read_csv_auto('examples/users.csv', sample_size=-1) ORDER BY id, name
distinct_by: SELECT CAST(id AS VARCHAR) AS id, CAST(name AS VARCHAR) AS name FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, name FROM read_csv_auto('examples/users.csv', sample_size=-1)) AS d ORDER BY id
extend_concat: SELECT CAST('https://example.org/' || id AS VARCHAR) AS iri FROM read_csv_auto('examples/users.csv', sample_size=-1) ORDER BY id
group_by_count: SELECT CAST(user_id AS VARCHAR) AS user_id, CAST(COUNT(id) AS VARCHAR) AS n FROM read_csv_auto('examples/orders.csv', sample_size=-1) GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY user_id
project_two_cols: SELECT CAST(id AS VARCHAR) AS id, CAST(name AS VARCHAR) AS name FROM read_csv_auto('examples/users.csv', sample_size=-1) ORDER BY id
r7_const_fold_extend: SELECT CAST('https://example.org/user' AS VARCHAR) AS subject FROM read_csv_auto('examples/users.csv', sample_size=-1) ORDER BY id
r8_drop_true_filter: SELECT CAST(id AS VARCHAR) AS id, CAST(name AS VARCHAR) AS name FROM read_csv_auto('examples/users.csv', sample_size=-1) ORDER BY id
rename_col: SELECT CAST(name AS VARCHAR) AS label FROM read_csv_auto('examples/users.csv', sample_size=-1) ORDER BY id
union_two_sources: SELECT CAST(id AS VARCHAR) AS id, CAST(name AS VARCHAR) AS name FROM ( SELECT id, name FROM read_csv_auto('examples/a.csv', sample_size=-1) UNION SELECT id, name FROM read_csv_auto('examples/b.csv', sample_size=-1) ) AS u ORDER BY id
